sasha (sec): Heads up — we need to finalize the policy for SIEM exports that may contain PII.

sasha (sec): My proposal: 1) windowization — only allow exports as rolling time buckets (configurable: 24h / 7d) instead of open-range dumps, 2) persist snapshots encrypted with our KMS key, 3) require JIT KMS unwrap and short-lived decryption tokens scoped to a ticket, 4) mask high-risk fields by default. Thoughts?

jordan (infra): quick Q — by windowization you mean pre-sliced S3 objects per time window, not truncating events, right? per-tenant or global buckets?

sasha (sec): yes — pre-sliced objects (e.g., /exports/2026-03-21/tenant-123/part-0001.gz). prevents one-off huge queries. default to per-tenant where possible, fall back to project-level when multitenant events exist.

nina (audits): +1 to masking defaults. propose retention TTLs: exports auto-expire after 7 days for non-forensic requests. forensic snapshots can be 30d but require sec lead + oncall approval and a signed justification. link to playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/siem-export (see Forensics section).

lee (oncall): incident note — during active IR we often need raw logs older than 7d. can we add a scoped "forensic-snapshot" flow that issues a one-time KMS unwrap token valid 1 hour and requires owner+sec approval? logs should be write-once, read-audit logged.

jordan (infra): technical feasibility: yes. implement with ephemeral role that has kms:Decrypt plus s3:GetObject for specific object ARNs. Token issued by a service that checks ticket + approvals. sample IAM condition snippet: 
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/EXPORT-SNAP-KEY",
  "Condition": {
    "StringEquals": {"aws:RequestTag/siem-ticket": "TICKET-1234"}
  }
}
```

sasha (sec): Also add RBAC constraints: only members of role "sec:analyst" or "oncall:forensics" can request unmasking. All requests create audit events with: requester, approvers, ticket id, reason, TTL. No manual key sharing allowed.

nina (audits): logging requirements: record KMS unwrap attempts (success+failure) as part of event store, tie to the ticket id. retention of audit trail should be 1y encrypted.

lee (oncall): operational checklist for a forensic snapshot: 1) open ticket, 2) request ephemeral snapshot via /ops/export, 3) sec lead approves, 4) system issues scoped token, 5) analyst downloads, 6) system rotates token and marks export as consumed. add a rollback if request is denied.

jordan (infra): couple of implementation caveats: 1) ensure S3 object metadata includes the mask-version so we know what fields were masked, 2) prevent cross-tenant leaks by enforcing object-level ACLs + bucket policies, 3) rate-limit export operations to avoid exfil.

sasha (sec): good call. also add automated heuristics to detect PII in exports and block by default with a human-in-loop override.

logbot: archiver-bot created export-request #4681 for TICKET-9876 (pending approvals) :lock:

nina (audits): sounds good. can someone draft the policy PR and a short playbook snippet? I can own the audit sections.

jordan (infra): I can do the IAM/KMS policy PR. will include the condition patterns and the sample object layout.

sasha (sec): I'll write the scoping rules and approval matrix.

lee (oncall): +1. if no objections I'll spin up a draft RFC by end of week. :thumbsup:

sasha (sec): no objections from me. thanks all.

jordan (infra): FYI we should also run a small canary export to make sure the unwrap flow emits the right audit events.

logbot: notice: canary-export job #canary-21 completed — logs available for review.
